entities.name: University of Applied Sciences Stuttgart
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Stuttgart Technical University of Applied Sciences is one of ten institutes for higher education in Stuttgart. It was founded in 1832 as a school for construction craftsmen and was inaugurated as a University of Applied Sciences in 1971.
